name: MI-shaping
definition: A training technique that shapes the NeRF network parameters by applying a contrastive loss on the gradients of pixel gray values with respect to the network weights, specifically targeting the RGB linear layer to improve mutual information between perturbed responses.
summary: MI-shaping is a training technique that improves NeRF suitability for semantic label propagation by applying a contrastive loss on pixel gradient weights to align the network's gradient space with semantic similarity.
